notes: Two taḥwīl branches (rule 3): the text writes «عن أبي هريرة» once, after the last «ح», so it closes both routes as the shared tail
«محمد بن مسلم» in the second route is written by name and is not merged with «الزهري» of the first (rule 9); the two names are left as the text writes them
«رجل، من مزينة» and «رجلا، من مزينة» are unnamed (rule 8); «ونحن عند سعيد بن المسيب» is the place where he was heard, not a link (rule 6)
«- ثم اتفقا -» and «- وهذا حديث معمر وهو أتم -» are Abu Dawud's glosses, left out
